concierge.name: Local Concierge (Remote)
concierge.shortPitch: A real local on WhatsApp for your first 72 hours in Chongqing — SIM, payments, transport, translation, re-planning.
concierge.depositNote: ¥100 deposit per order after we confirm scope and capacity; ¥100 balance. Confirmed in writing before any payment.

first-night.name: First Night in Chongqing
first-night.shortPitch: Land, get connected, check in, and eat your first hotpot with a local by your side.
first-night.depositNote: Proposed price — we confirm the team, transport and total in writing before any payment.

private.name: Private Day with a Local Guide
private.shortPitch: Your own English-speaking guide and driver, at your pace.
private.depositNote: Standard day proposed at ¥1,600 — written quote first for your route, host and total. No payment until confirmed.

first-night-family.name: First Night — Family Pace
first-night-family.shortPitch: The same first night, at family pace: shorter walks, breaks every 45 minutes, mild food options.
first-night-family.depositNote: Kids under 6 or car-seat needs: we confirm fit in writing before any payment.

non-spicy-food-tour.name: Non-Spicy Food Walk
non-spicy-food-tour.shortPitch: Chongqing flavour without the chilli challenge — four tastings and a drink, all included.
non-spicy-food-tour.ctaLabel: Check the food walk for my group
non-spicy-food-tour.depositNote: Severe allergies? Message us first — if we can't keep you safe, we say so and don't sell.
